subject: sdm.inla Probit issues when attempting to implement binomial link

messages.author: b2e8776c7aa46423
messages.subject: sdm.inla Probit issues when attempting to implement binomial link
parts:
Following the example for ?sdm.inla I get the followoing error:

Error in inla.set.hyper(family[i.family], "likelihood", cont.family[[i.family]]$hyper,  :
  Model binomial [ likelihood ], has none hyperparameters, but 'hyper' is  list(prec = list(initial = 25, fixed = TRUE))

My model follows the example, with the adjustments to make it probit.

zero.tolerance <- list(prec=list(initial = 25, fixed=TRUE))
inla1 <-   sdm.inla(form, d=data_complete, W=W.reg, rho=.9
, family = 'binomial'
, mmatrix = mm
, impacts=FALSE
, Ntrials = nrow(data_complete)
, control.family = list(hyper = zero.tolerance, link = 'probit')
, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
, control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE)
, control.inla=list(print.joint.hyper=TRUE)
#tolerance=1e-20, h=1e-6),
, verbose=TRUE
, probit = TRUE
)

I've tried a myriad of variations, with
family = 'gaussian'
adding
Ntrials= nrows(data)
sdm.inla() is a function from the INLABMA package

Can someone point me to the correct settings to perform the Probit Spatial Durbin Model?  Thanks!

the error, is that prior spesification is given for the binomial
likelihood, which does not have any parameters.
